<br>

## What this manual covers

The Operations Manual describes **what BNR work must happen, who is responsible, where decisions occur and what evidence is retained**. It covers the whole registry pathway, from identifying a potential event to correcting or maintaining an approved public release.

The manual is public by design. It explains BNR procedures and controls without publishing patient information, credentials, protected extracts or live security details.

## The three BNR manuals

| Manual | Main purpose |
|---|---|
| **Operations Manual** | Govern the complete registry process and record operational decisions. |
| **[Technical Manual](../technical/index.qmd)** | Operate and maintain the post-REDCap analytics and publishing tools. |
| **[Public Methods Manual](../methods/index.qmd)** | Explain what BNR statistics mean and how they should be interpreted. |

The Operations Manual states the required process. Where a task needs menus, dialogs, commands or file paths, it links to the Technical Manual instead of repeating those instructions.

## Status of this edition

The post-REDCap analytics and publishing pages describe the implemented BNR refit system as step-by-step operational overviews, with links to detailed Technical Manual instructions. Pages covering work before and within REDCap remain visible BNR-team drafts so staff can suggest, complete and approve the local procedures.
